title: Financing Certificate Platform for a Berlin Real Estate Service
excerpt: Full-stack platform with automated PDF certificates, 10-step financing form, and admin dashboard for OHYP GmbH - a real estate service helping property buyers prove their creditworthiness to agents and sellers in under 24 hours.
challenge: OHYP GmbH needed a digital platform to issue personal financing certificates for real estate buyers in Germany. Their service helps buyers prove their creditworthiness to real estate agents and property sellers - but the existing process was manual and slow. Buyers needed to receive a binding certificate within 24 hours - without a SCHUFA credit inquiry - while the system automatically compared over 550 partner banks.
solution: We developed a full-stack platform with a 10-step financing form as the core conversion element, automated PDF certificate generation with one-click download, and an admin dashboard for managing the complete request lifecycle. The platform uses tRPC for end-to-end type safety, PostgreSQL for data persistence, and Better Auth for secure session management.

testimonial.quote: webvise delivered a production-ready platform that exceeded our expectations. The automated certificate flow and the conversion-optimized funnel have become core to how we operate. Reliable, fast, and always thinking ahead.
testimonial.author: R. Hainbach
